messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Personal and Family Relationships" as it appears in the following examples.
['Please I implore you in the name of God to assist me and my sister in this regard as our life is no longer safe here.', 'We we remarried for twelve years and God blessed us with twin’s children.', 'I need the money to take care of the family left behind of about two wives and six children.', 'I am presently in distress and under house arrest while my son Mohammed is undergoing trial in Lagos and Abuja though he has just been recently granted bail under the condition that my family refunds to the Federal Government some amount of money.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}

message.content: {"summary":"I seek help to protect my sister and family, support my wives and children, and navigate distress surrounding my son’s trial and bail."}
